title: Happy Halloween - A cozy & short witch story
author: FrankenChocula

comments.author: FrankenChocula
comments.body:
Sharing a comment since this is a cross-post.

**Happy Halloween, folks!**

I wanted to share this short little story game where you play a little witch and complete a few tasks around a small town.

The game name is ironically *Hollowmere*. I'm not sure how many Hollowmere games I've seen, but AI really seems to love that name. So here's one more for Halloween. 😄

It's pretty short, but I loved the cozy Halloween style and thought you all might like it, too. Enjoy!

Playable fully in-browser, no downloads/accounts needed.

[Hollowmere](https://wonky.date/hollowmere/hollowmere.html) \- [https://wonky.date/hollowmere/hollowmere.html](https://wonky.date/hollowmere/hollowmere.html)
